beats.care: A lowkey new weekend plan: Australian and Madagascar animals you'd otherwise only see abroad, right near the Old City.
beats.what: Zoo officials say a pair each of kangaroos, wallabies and ring-tailed lemurs will come from Vantara, a wildlife centre in Jamnagar.
beats.why: Vantara's team inspected the zoo and agreed in principle to share animals. An earlier kangaroo deal with Japan fell through in 2020.

cards.body: Cassowaries, large flightless birds, are also expected, and a second zebra pair is planned. The zoo already has 3 zebras from Vantara. Officials gave no date, saying Vantara is busy with rescue work.
To beat El Niño heat, the zoo has added sprinklers, foggers and air conditioners in enclosures.

opts: To shelter animals from a climate unlike home
Because they only eat at night
cards.q: Why does the new kangaroo pair need a 'night house'?
cards.why: Animals from other climates need protected spaces to rest safely, away from heat and crowds.

hook: Kangaroos in Hyderabad? The zoo's *first-ever pair* is coming.

learn.t: Hyderabad's zoo tried to get kangaroos from Japan in 2020, but the Covid pandemic stopped the deal.

sources.name: Telangana Today
sources.title: Hyderabad Zoo to welcome kangaroos, wallabies and lemurs

tldr: Nehru Zoological Park will get its first-ever kangaroos, plus wallabies and ring-tailed lemurs, from Vantara in Jamnagar, though no arrival date is set.
